# rekordbox demo export

`export.pdb` is the rekordbox USB export of rekordbox's bundled demo tracks,
from the rekordcrate project:

https://github.com/Holzhaus/rekordcrate, `data/complete_export/demo_tracks/PIONEER/rekordbox/export.pdb`
at commit 14d54ed, used under the Mozilla Public License 2.0
(https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/).

The tests use it as a real export.pdb to read. The audio it refers to is not
included: the tests make stand-in files at the same paths.
